{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|I've been from one end of this galaxy to the other, and I've never seen another house like this one. It's a new concept of mine&mdash;houses that float in the sky. If you don't like the cloud you're living on, you just drift off to another one.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
A '''sky house''' was a type of home which hovered in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by means of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]]. The concept was invented by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who built a [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]] of their own in the skies of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="Zorba the Hutt's Revenge">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>
